FRONIMUS UPDATE v0.1.2.1

  1. Critical bug fix with new render system.
  2. Also spiders was nerfed
  3. World from 0.1.2 compatable

FRONIMUS UPDATE v0.1.2

This update focuses on optimization, world generation, combat improvements, and better WebGL support.

The previous WebGL version was mostly for testing, but I saw that people actually want to play it in the browser. Because of that, I made many changes to keep WebGL performance good enough to play.

Performance

  1. Optimized chunk rendering. Worlds should now load and fill much faster.
  2. Fixed a Cave Occlusion bug that could make worlds unplayable after long sessions.
  3. Optimized chunk sending for the internal server. Chunk loading should now feel faster and smoother.
  4. Improved WebGL performance.

Combat

  1. Added projectile mechanics.
  2. Added dynamite to test projectile and explosion behavior.
  3. Added a decoy bomb just for fun.
  4. Mobs are now more aggressive.
  5. Spiders can now detect players from a longer distance and deal more damage.

Commands

  1. Added double tap forward autorun
  2. Added `/setspawn` command for cheat-enabled worlds.

World Generation

  1. Generation overhaul.
  2. Added new mineshaft generation with random loot.
  3. The engine now supports large “mega structures” generated with a wave collapse system.

Visual Changes

  1. Updated grass rendering.
  2. Updated leaves rendering.
  3. Updated fire VFX.

Important: old worlds may not work correctly with this version. Adding full world compatibility would take much more time than I expected, so I decided to focus on improving the game first.

Project has been in development for a little over a year, and this is the earliest version I'm ready to share. Right now the game only has the basic mechanics try things out and experiment. Most of the game is still in development (the BETA 0.0.0 version kind of hints at that)

I’d be grateful if you joined my Discord I regularly post news and update teasers there, and it’s also a quick way to leave feedback and report bugs

Discord link....new one: https://discord.gg/xHBE4kdpMK

⚠️ WARNING: The game runs a local server and uses port 15551

Allow firewall access only if you want others to connect to you (LAN/Internet) Otherwise, deny it

Music by: Vercius - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCOBJMP0EfsqAyL-uhNq4wrg

Thanks, and enjoy the game!
